idea: Each item goes in whole or stays out. Build a table: row i, column w holds the best value using the first i items with room w. Each cell is the better of skipping item i (the cell above) or taking it (value plus the cell above and to the left by its weight).
useWhen: Choosing the best set of whole items under a weight limit
Budget problems where each option is all or nothing
avoidWhen: Items can be split (use the fractional version: it is faster and simpler)
The capacity W is huge: the table grows with it
